phase_note: Fase 1 (tahap 00–06): ARC-native, fokus WhatsApp → analisis → relasi & peta → pipeline → MCP. Fase 2 (07–13): brief, Odoo, Gmail, Kas, growth, hardening.

stages.name: Bootstrap repo, ADR, tooling
stages.summary: Repo Go (modul arc) + apps/web React + apps/wa-bridge; ADR 0003 (Go/React/PostgreSQL); Makefile dev/test/lint/seed/eval/perf; compose + Caddy; .env.example lengkap; gitleaks config.
stages.notes: Docker tidak tersedia di mesin dev: compose divalidasi sintaks saja.

stages.name: Domain model & storage (ARC-native)
stages.summary: Skema PostgreSQL (migrasi SQL tertanam, audit log append-only), seed fixture mockup idempoten, health v1 (RSUD 43).
stages.notes: Pengganti mypy strict: sistem tipe Go + go vet (ADR 0003).

stages.name: WhatsApp bridge & capture (QR + Cloud API adapter, grup, nomor internal)
stages.summary: wa-bridge Node + Baileys (ADR 0004) multi-sesi QR (QR asli terbukti), riwayat, grup, profil; kirim hanya action approved (cek ulang HMAC, idempoten per action) dan lolos penjaga anti-blokir (kontak dingin, opt-out, broadcast, jam tenang, 20/jam·120/hari, pemanasan, jeda + mengetik); antrean file; webhook HMAC, privasi grup/internal, parser ekspor, Cloud API adapter, FakeTransport.
stages.notes: Uji kirim/terima dengan nomor cadangan belum (docs/testing/whatsapp.md).

stages.name: Reasoning core: ekstraksi, identitas, memori
stages.summary: Capture (komitmen/sinyal/tugas + evidence), identitas inbound (rantai sumber), research tangga solusi + 5 pertanyaan, memori akun, hygiene, LLM router + masking PII + biaya, eval.

stages.name: Web v1: Chat, Relasi + peta stakeholder + Peta 3D, Pengaturan WA, Hari ini lite
stages.summary: Web React sesuai mockup: Hari ini, Chat, Relasi + peta stakeholder, Peta 3D (Three.js), Pengaturan WA; semua data dari API; 400 px tanpa scroll horizontal.
stages.notes: Uji manual QR→Chat≤5 dtk menunggu nomor cadangan.

stages.name: Pipeline & deal intelligence (ARC-native) + Prospek inbound + Action sheet
stages.summary: Health & flag 8 opportunity, forecast commit/best/pipeline Rp 4,3/5,9/11,9 M + what-if, NBA table-driven (rules/nba.json), funnel 7 tahap, Prospek → lead, Action sheet.

stages.name: MCP server, AI API, Ask
stages.summary: MCP Streamable HTTP + OAuth 2.1 (PKCE, DCR), tools sesuai mockup, decide human-only, scoping cabang, REST /api/v1 + OpenAPI, Ask dengan evidence, API key + rate limit, webhook keluar HMAC.

stages.name: Brief harian, approval lengkap, kalibrasi, notifier
stages.summary: Brief 06.45/16.00 (4 poin + evidence), approval penuh (approve/edit/opsi/tolak/tunda), suppress 14 hari, LearnedRule 3×, kalibrasi, notifier.

stages.name: Odoo read-only sync & penautan (Odoo jadi source of truth)
stages.summary: Odoo XML-RPC read-only (stdlib), sync idempoten (write_date), penautan 6 otomatis + 2 usulan + create_in_odoo, L2C 6 kasus.

stages.name: Gmail & Calendar capture
stages.summary: Gmail/Calendar: 12 email → 9 tertaut/2 unresolved/1 diabaikan, tanpa kutipan, idempoten; meeting prep H-1.

stages.name: Odoo write-back (guarded)
stages.summary: Writer Odoo terbatas (whitelist, tanpa stage_id/unlink): probability + note evidence, activity komitmen, konflik → Signal sync_conflict. Komitmen kami → mail.activity, terpenuhi → action_done (job odoo_activities).

stages.name: Cash engine & Collection agent
stages.summary: Cash engine: L2C per project vs benchmark, create_invoice/pengingat/ask_spm_documents/schedule_bast, prediksi kas Rp 2,4 M + what-if, aging, CSV.

stages.name: Growth: funnel & flywheel, tender radar, tim, renewal & ekspansi, denyut bisnis
stages.summary: Flywheel (verdict berbalik bila data dibalik), tender radar 92/84/71, renewal Amarta offer_maintenance, coaching tim (Fajar 0 lead/102 pesan).

stages.name: Hardening & go-live
stages.summary: Validasi config production, watchdog sesi WA >10 mnt, alert job gagal 2× & biaya, /api/metrics, backup/restore pg_dump, perf 500 akun/10k interaksi p95 < 300 ms, Playwright smoke + e2e, runbook, go-live checklist, pelatihan sales.
stages.notes: Belum: restore di mesin bersih, 48 jam staging, tanda tangan Sam (docs/go-live-checklist.md).

stack: Go 1.26 · PostgreSQL 17 · React + Vite · Node + Baileys untuk wa-bridge (ADR 0003/0004)
